entries.speaker: Beaten Volleyball Player
entries.en: I don't know why you guys are here...[n]but just leave us alone...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What're you talkin' about!?[n]You're seriously okay with this!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Tch... I guess there's no point[n]tryin' to talk to 'em...

entries.speaker: Despondent Volleyball Player
entries.en: I don't want people to glare[n]at me like they do to you...[n]Don't drag me into your mess...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: That don't matter! You seriously[n]don't care about gettin' treated[n]like shit!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: *sigh* I guess there ain't a point[n]in sayin' any of this...
